description: This file defines the class SendFeatureMessageResponse, a specialized response message class used within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It specifically handles responses from a feature sending a message back to a sender, encapsulating the message payload, thing ID, feature ID, HTTP status, headers, and JSON serialization/deserialization mechanisms.

classes.name: SendFeatureMessageResponse
classes.description: A response message class specific for feature messages, handling serialization/deserialization, feature ID validation, and encapsulating response details such as thing ID, feature ID, status, headers, and payload.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of SendFeatureMessageResponse with provided thing ID, feature ID, message, status code, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a SendFeatureMessageResponse from a JSON string or object, validating and extracting necessary fields.

methods.name: validateMessageFeatureId
methods.description: Checks that the message's feature ID matches the expected feature ID, throwing an exception if not.
